coordinateSystem.sourceRectFormat: [left, top, width, height] in atlas pixels, integer bounds with 2px padding around alpha>=8 extent
coordinateSystem.rootPxFormat: [x,y] in full-atlas pixels; planted lower stem/root median of last3 visible alpha>=8 rows, rounded to integer

alpha.warning: The generated PNG contains alpha1-7 fringe noise, including bright RGB values at extremely low alpha. No bright-yellow pixels were found at alpha>=8 in the read-only check. Preserve source PNG and discard the faint fringe in material alphaTest. Do not render every alpha1 pixel as visible geometry bounds.

integration.material: sRGB atlas, linear filtering/mipmaps, DoubleSide as appropriate, alphaTest0.05; neutral matte lighting matching the world. Use native depth and shadows and actual rooted transform.
integration.uvRectFormula: u0=x/W,u1=(x+w)/W; vTop=1-y/H,vBottom=1-(y+h)/H when using standard bottom-left UV coordinates. Respect texture-upload flipY convention exactly once.
integration.rootToWorldFormula: For a pixel (px,py) and chosen worldHeight: localX=(px-rootPx.x)/sourceRect.height*worldHeight; localY=(rootPx.y-py)/sourceRect.height*worldHeight. WorldWidth=sourceRect.width/sourceRect.height*worldHeight. If centering a plane: centerOffsetX=(0.5-rootNormalized.x)*worldWidth; centerOffsetY=(rootNormalized.y-0.5)*worldHeight.
integration.scale: At a girl height of roughly100-125 CSSpx, grasses are about10-30px tall. Use sparse irregular unequal clumps. twig is a unique larger foreground piece; never scatter it as a generic meadow object.
integration.wind: Small root-locked upper-blade sway only. No full-card bob or root translation.
integration.ground: Actual terrain point supplies world root; cards must be occluded by real land/stone/road and cast modest alpha-tested shadows.
integration.runtimeLimit: This atlas is isolated local vegetation only. Do not use concept.png as a world plane or claim these assets implement interaction, path continuity or acceptance.
